Investigate a worker/database race: an enqueued job sometimes runs before the creating transaction commits and reads missing data. Trace the transaction, enqueue, and worker-read ordering; fix the cause and add a deterministic regression test. Limit changes to this flow; preserve successful-job behavior.
排查 worker 与数据库的竞态：入队任务有时在创建它的事务提交前执行，读不到数据。追踪事务、入队和 worker 读取的顺序，修复根因并添加确定性回归测试。只改这一条流程，保持成功任务的行为不变。

Review tenant isolation and token revocation across an API gateway, session store, and asynchronous workers. Analyze concurrent token rotation, revocation during store outages, and sensitive data leakage in telemetry; provide evidence, attack timelines, trade-offs, and a minimal remediation and regression-test plan. Do not change files.
审查 API 网关、会话存储和异步 worker 之间的租户隔离与令牌撤销。分析并发令牌轮换、存储故障期间撤销以及遥测中的敏感数据泄漏，给出证据、攻击时序、权衡和最小修复与回归测试计划。不要修改文件。
